name: Societe De Conseil En Externalisation Et En Marketing Internet Societe Anonyme
summary: Societe De Conseil En Externalisation Et En Marketing Internet Société Anonyme provides data entry and processing services. It also offers data entry and processing, multichannel customer relations, business process outsourcing, marketing content management, and opinion data analysis services. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Boulogne Billancourt, France.
